name: @preimage/gaussian-splat-viewer-v2
description: An advanced 3D Gaussian Splatting renderer for THREE.js

forkNotes: This package's `version` is OUR OWN line and is unrelated to upstream Spark's.
They were the same field until 3.0.0, which collided: 2.4.0 / 2.4.1 / 2.4.2 were
published here off a Spark 2.3.1 base, so when upstream actually released 2.4.0
there was no version left to publish it as. Hence the jump to 3.0.0 and the split:
`version` = our artifact, `sparkBase` = the upstream tag we are rebased onto.
Keep `sparkBase` truthful - it is the only machine-readable record of what this is,
so update it in the SAME commit as any upstream rebase.
Local deltas on top of sparkBase. Sizes are `git diff --numstat` against the
sparkBase tag, additions first. (A bare --stat against that tag also reports
~50k deletions under dist/: upstream COMMITS its build output and we gitignore
it. Those are not code changes.)
- the 3DGUT-matched renderer, 11 files: splatVertex.glsl +693, SparkRenderer.ts
+214 -2, splat_encode.rs +117 -5, gutDefines.glsl +104 (new), splatFragment.glsl
+58, splatDefines.glsl +47 -3, SplatAccumulator.ts +31 -2, dyno/output.ts +16 -3,
ext_splats.rs +4 -4, shaders.ts +3, index.ts +3. Exposed as the `gutMode`
option plus `gut`/DEFAULT_GUT_SETTINGS (GutRenderSettings) and `gutCamera`.
This is FullCircle's renderer, validated against NVIDIA 3DGRUT's CUDA
reference (62-79 dB vs 19-29 for stock Spark on their corpus). It REPLACED an
earlier local port of ours that only estimated the 2D covariance from sigma
points; that port was reverted first so the patch applies to clean sparkBase.
Applied unmodified in its own commit, so a future refresh diffs cleanly.
- ONE deliberate edit on top of it, also in splatVertex.glsl: Spark's LoD
encodes merged-splat opacity as alpha > 1 and the patch's gutSplat reads
rgba.a straight into `opacity`, so paged RAD needed that decoded at the call
site. Upstream of us never hit it - that viewer only loads one flat PLY.
Marked `// PREIMAGE:` in the source.
- clustered-SH read support in spark-lib: gsplat.rs +101 (GsplatArray's
set_sh_labels / set_sh*_codes, which are empty stubs upstream through v2.4.0).
- build-lod --no-lod: build-lod/src/main.rs +28, exports splats without
rebuilding an LoD tree.
The GLSL is not compile-checked by tsc, the unit tests or build:wasm - all three
pass with a broken shader. gutMode is therefore still OFF in every viewer tier
pending a browser A/B; see preimage-viewer-v2/tasks.md section 2.

scripts.build: npm run build:production && npm run build:dev && npm run build:types
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist/ && rm -rf node_modules/ && rm -rf rust/target/ && rm -rf rust/spark-rs/pkg/ && npm run assets:clean
scripts.dev: npm run build:dev && (vite --host & npm run build:watch)
scripts.docs: node scripts/clean-site-files.js && node scripts/copy-site-files.js && mkdocs serve
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:wasm && npm run build
scripts.site:build:relativeurls: npm run build && npm run site:clean && node scripts/copy-site-files.js && mkdocs build && node scripts/rename-assets-to-static.js && node scripts/replace-urls.js
scripts.site:build: npm run build && npm run site:clean && node scripts/copy-site-files.js && mkdocs build && node scripts/rename-assets-to-static.js
